title: Designing bimetallic IrRu nanoparticles on oxygen-deficient WO3 for efficient NO reduction by CO
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,1097-1111
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01096A, Paper
Wenjun Zhang, Yanshan Gao, Qiang Wang
A bimetallic IrRu nanoparticle catalyst supported on oxygen-deficient WO3 is developed, leading to a significant enhancement in NO reduction efficiency and N2 selectivity under oxygen-rich conditions.
